abilities.tooltip: Take a post. Left to right: squad leader, elite, scavenger, technician, lookout.

zones.tooltip: What has just been announced and not yet answered. Codex has no instants, so nothing waits here for long.

zones.label: Combat
zones.tooltip: Where an attacker and its target stand while the blows land. Nothing waits here: a combat begins and ends inside one action.

zones.label: In play
zones.tooltip: Upgrades and ongoing spells. They cannot be attacked.

zones.label: Patrol
zones.tooltip: Squad leader, elite, scavenger, technician, lookout — left to right. The leader has 1 armor and must be dealt with first; the elite has +1 ATK; a scavenger finds its owner a gold when it dies and a technician a card.

zones.label: Base
zones.tooltip: Twenty hit points. Lose it and you lose the game.

zones.label: Tech
zones.tooltip: Your finished tech buildings. Each lets you play cards of its tier.

zones.label: Building
zones.tooltip: Under construction. It finishes at the start of your next turn.

zones.label: Command
zones.tooltip: Your hero waits here to be summoned, and comes back here when it dies.

zones.label: Deck
zones.tooltip: Your draw pile. Run it out and your discard is shuffled back in.

zones.label: Discard
zones.tooltip: Face down to everybody else: this is where your codex picks land.

zones.label: Workers
zones.tooltip: Cards turned face down to work. One gold each, every upkeep.

phases.label: Tech: take two cards from your codex
